seed_policy.scope_per_case_repeat: fresh Java registered users/products/SKUs; no Python writes to transaction tables

annotation_basis: Manually specified typed receipts, Java outcomes and invariant checks before execution; not derived from test pass counts, sampled model outcomes or RAG/holdout content.

execution_contract.agent_multistep: Actual Shopping chooses tools/proposals in live mode. Direct UI requests may perform predeclared setup or explicit user confirmations, never stand in for an Agent action. Mock cannot validate these Agent capabilities.
execution_contract.service_reliability: Real authenticated HTTP/Java persistence checks, reported separately from Agent completion.
execution_contract.controlled_provider_fault: Requires explicitly tagged and root-approved scope-bound transport fault adapter; does not claim live model quality. No adapter means NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL_REQUIRED.
execution_contract.confirmation: Every order/payment/cancel/refund/grant write needs the predeclared concrete user or merchant confirmation; model prose/documents/expected labels never approve.
execution_contract.failure_recovery: Keep original request IDs and any charged/spent/financial facts. Read old receipts before same-key recovery. Retain all failed, setup_failed, not_triggered and not_run cases.
execution_contract.external_restart: Only root schedules actual Smartlect-owned API restart serially; runner waits on a scope/proposal-bound checkpoint with actual changed PID and health evidence. No automatic WSL/Docker/other-project restart.
execution_contract.expiry: Wait actual recorded proposal TTL; never change application/DB clocks or shorten authority TTL. Waiting is separate from model budget.
execution_contract.scoring: Overall tool-task target >=90% correct completion/refusal/escalation of predeclared20; show Agent/live subset separately. Missing required semantic review or external proof cannot be counted passed. HTTP200, keyword matching and model self-grading alone are insufficient.
execution_contract.strong_invariants: All listed invariant violation counts must equal0 independently of the90% task threshold; not-measured remainsnull and cannot count as0.
execution_contract.outputs: Per-case actual user/merchant requests, model attempts and tool receipts, proposal decisions, Java statuses/stock, Growth ledger/ads details, stage errors, time/wait costs, version hashes; raw failures retained.
